inputs.text:
It is utterly shameful what our so-called leaders are doing to our national honor. While the Middle East is burning, this compromised government has completely abandoned traditional American strength and national resolve. Instead of standing firmly with our greatest ally, they went behind the scenes and proposed a humiliating 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan. It is an absolute disgrace to our sovereignty.

Naturally, that rogue regime in Tehran spat right in our face, coming back with five counter-conditions, demanding an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty. This is the inevitable, predictable result when weak-kneed leaders try to appease hostile actors instead of upholding law, order, and deterrence. 

Thank God Israel still has some backbone. Israel remains sceptical of Iran's acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict. While our own institutions pursue feckless diplomacy that betrays our values and emboldens radicals, at least our allies in the region understand that national survival requires strength, personal responsibility, and a firm refusal to bow down.
